summary: Rewrote q2-q4 as neutral questions without embedded answers, non-goal instructions, or internal implementation detail.

items.title: 1. q2 embeds the proposed test strategy
items.rationale: Replaced the proposed must/should unit/e2e split with a neutral question asking which scope each test layer should fix.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[1].question now asks `unit tests と e2e tests でそれぞれどの範囲を固定しますか`.

items.title: 2. q3 embeds acceptance answers and internal detail
items.rationale: Removed the preselected acceptance answer and internal `agent.call` detail from the question.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[2].question now asks `prompt 上限超過時の受け入れ条件は何ですか`.

items.title: 3. q4 embeds a non-goal instruction
items.rationale: Removed the embedded must-level non-goal and rewrote the question to ask for the out-of-scope boundary.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[3].question now asks `対象外とする review-test 関連の変更範囲は何ですか`.
